title: Search Preserves Polynomial Space
statement: For a language $P$ of Boolean words, define its search language to consist of those Boolean words $x$ for which there is a natural number $u<2^{|x|}$ such that the encoded pair of $x$ and the binary expansion of $u$ belongs to $P$. If $P$ is decidable by a finite-state multi-tape Turing machine using at most a constant multiple of $n^c+1$ work-tape cells on inputs of length $n$, for some natural number $c$, then the search language of $P$ also has such a polynomial-space decision procedure.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ belongs to PSPACE, meaning some natural number $c$ and finite-state machine decide it using space at most $n^c+1$ times a natural-number constant
